prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: side impact at intersection in Sugar Land, Texas. Injury: neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1271; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was driving through the intersection on a green light when a vehicle coming from my right entered at speed and struck the driver's side of my car. The impact pushed my vehicle sideways into the curb. I did not see the other car until it was already on top of me, and I had no time to brake or steer away. I have given this same account every time I have described the collision, to the other driver, to the responding officer, and to my insurer. I am the named driver on this policy and was operating my own vehicle at the time. Shortly after the crash I felt stiffness and pain in my neck and upper back, which later was diagnosed as a neck strain. I am still receiving treatment and have been limited in turning my head and lifting, so I am requesting coverage for the medical costs and the repairs to my vehicle.
